requirements.quote:
Transport parameters with an identifier of the form "31 * N + 27" for
   integer values of N are reserved to exercise the requirement that
   unknown transport parameters be ignored.  These transport parameters
   have no semantics and can carry arbitrary values.
requirements.condition: A transport parameter identifier equals 31 * N + 27 for an integer N.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat the identifier as a reserved transport parameter identifier.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Treat the identifier as defining a non-reserved transport parameter solely by virtue of its numeric value.
requirements.why_checkable: The reserved identifier set is defined by an exact arithmetic form that can be checked against implementation classification logic.

requirements.quote:
Transport parameters with an identifier of the form "31 * N + 27" for
   integer values of N are reserved to exercise the requirement that
   unknown transport parameters be ignored.  These transport parameters
   have no semantics and can carry arbitrary values.
requirements.condition: An implementation receives an unknown transport parameter, including a reserved transport parameter with an identifier of the form 31 * N + 27.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Process the unknown transport parameter as having defined protocol semantics.
requirements.error_behavior: Do not reject the transport parameters merely because the unknown transport parameter is present.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can supply an unknown or reserved transport parameter and verify that processing continues without applying semantics or reporting an error solely for its presence.

requirements.quote:
Transport parameters with an identifier of the form "31 * N + 27" for
   integer values of N are reserved to exercise the requirement that
   unknown transport parameters be ignored.  These transport parameters
   have no semantics and can carry arbitrary values.
requirements.condition: An implementation receives a reserved transport parameter whose identifier has the form 31 * N + 27.
requirements.required_behavior: Allow the parameter to contain an arbitrary value and ignore it without interpreting that value.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Assign protocol semantics to the reserved transport parameter or its value.
requirements.error_behavior: Do not reject the parameter based solely on the contents of its arbitrary value.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can vary the value carried by a reserved parameter and verify that the implementation neither interprets the value nor rejects it solely because of its contents.
